cards.example_en: Her painting of the lake was impressive at the show.
cards.example_zh: 她画的那幅湖景在展览上令人印象深刻。

cards.example_en: The hero is an incarnation of courage in that old adventure film.
cards.example_zh: 在那部老冒险片里，主人公是勇气的化身。

cards.example_en: Menus improve with the inclusion of fresh fruit at lunch.
cards.example_zh: 午餐菜单因为纳入新鲜水果而变得更好。

cards.example_en: Sorry for the inconvenience, but the lift is closed for repair.
cards.example_zh: 电梯正在维修，给您带来不便，非常抱歉。

cards.example_en: Sugar is the main ingredient in this homemade strawberry cake.
cards.example_zh: 糖是这块自制草莓蛋糕的主要原料。

cards.example_en: Be careful, or you may injure your knee on the icy road.
cards.example_zh: 小心，不然你可能会在结冰的路上伤到膝盖。

cards.example_en: Blue ink spilled across my notebook during the art lesson.
cards.example_zh: 美术课上，蓝墨水洒在了我的笔记本上。

cards.example_en: We stayed at a quiet inn beside the lake last weekend.
cards.example_zh: 上周末，我们住在湖边一家安静的小旅馆里。

cards.example_en: Before the school trip, an inspector checked every bus carefully.
cards.example_zh: 学校旅行开始前，一位检查员仔细检查了每一辆公共汽车。

cards.example_en: Please instruct the new players before the football match starts.
cards.example_zh: 足球比赛开始前，请指导一下新队员。

cards.example_en: In daylight, the tiny crack in the glass was almost invisible.
cards.example_zh: 在日光下，玻璃上的那道细裂纹几乎看不见。

cards.example_en: I received an invitation to my cousin's birthday party on Sunday.
cards.example_zh: 我收到了星期天参加表哥生日聚会的请柬。

cards.example_en: Please italicize the book title when you type the reading list.
cards.example_zh: 录入阅读书单时，请把书名排成斜体。

cards.example_en: Jam filled the jar that Grandma sealed last summer.
cards.example_zh: 果酱装满了奶奶去年夏天封好的广口瓶。

cards.example_en: Tom felt jealous when his brother got a new bicycle.
cards.example_zh: 弟弟得到一辆新自行车时，汤姆感到很嫉妒。

cards.example_en: Can you juggle three apples without dropping them on the floor?
cards.example_zh: 你能抛接三个苹果，还不让它们掉到地上吗？

cards.example_en: Lucy is keen on swimming and goes to the pool every morning.
cards.example_zh: 露西热衷于游泳，每天早上去游泳池。

cards.example_en: Near the park, police stopped a man who tried to kidnap the child.
cards.example_zh: 在公园附近，警察拦住了一个企图绑架那个孩子的男子。

cards.example_en: Last night police caught the kidnapper near the railway station.
cards.example_zh: 昨晚警察在火车站附近抓住了绑架者。

cards.example_en: Players kneel on the grass when they tie their football boots.
cards.example_zh: 球员系足球鞋带时跪在草地上。

cards.example_en: We heated the liquid in the laboratory during chemistry class.
cards.example_zh: 化学课上，我们在实验室里加热了那种液体。

cards.example_en: Visitors photograph the old clock tower, a famous landmark in our city.
cards.example_zh: 游客拍摄那座老钟楼，它是我们城市的著名地标。

cards.example_en: Doctors used a laser to treat the player's injured eye.
cards.example_zh: 医生用激光治疗了那位球员受伤的眼睛。

cards.example_en: A volunteer handed me a leaflet at the weekend book sale.
cards.example_zh: 周末售书时，一位志愿者递给我一张宣传单。

cards.example_en: Before moving in, the family signed a lease for a flat near school.
cards.example_zh: 入住前，这家人签了学校附近一套公寓的租约。

cards.example_en: On hot days I drink lemonade under the tree in our garden.
cards.example_zh: 天热的日子里，我在花园的树下喝柠檬水。

cards.example_en: Along the mountain path, grey lichen grows on the wet rocks.
cards.example_zh: 沿着山路，灰色的地衣长在潮湿的岩石上。

cards.example_en: A healthy diet can help increase a person's lifespan.
cards.example_zh: 健康的饮食有助于延长人的寿命。

cards.example_en: His lifestyle changed when he started cycling to work.
cards.example_zh: 他开始骑自行车上班以后，生活方式变了。

cards.example_en: Grandpa says this trip is the best holiday of his lifetime.
cards.example_zh: 爷爷说，这次旅行是他一生中最好的假期。

cards.example_en: The recipe needs a litre of milk and two eggs.
cards.example_zh: 这个食谱需要一升牛奶和两个鸡蛋。

cards.example_en: A lone bird sat on the roof before the storm arrived.
cards.example_zh: 暴风雨来临前，有一只鸟独自停在屋顶上。

cards.example_en: Loosen your tie if you feel too hot during the match.
cards.example_zh: 如果比赛时觉得太热，就把领带松开。

cards.example_en: At dawn a big lorry carried fresh vegetables into the market.
cards.example_zh: 黎明时分，一辆大卡车把新鲜蔬菜运进了市场。

cards.example_en: I forgot my lunchbox on the kitchen table this morning.
cards.example_zh: 今天早上，我把午餐盒忘在厨房的桌子上了。

cards.example_en: This lychee is sweet, so I bought a bag at the fruit stall.
cards.example_zh: 这荔枝很甜，所以我在水果摊买了一袋。

cards.example_en: Madame Chen welcomed the guests at the door of the hotel.
cards.example_zh: 陈夫人在旅馆门口迎接客人。

cards.example_en: She put on light make-up before the school concert began.
cards.example_zh: 学校音乐会开始前，她化了淡妆。

cards.example_en: During summer, families row on the man-made lake in the park.
cards.example_zh: 夏天，家家户户在公园的人工湖上划船。

cards.example_en: This old camera is manual and has no screen.
cards.example_zh: 这台旧相机是手动的，没有屏幕。

cards.example_en: Local workers manufacture bicycles for schools across the city.
cards.example_zh: 本地工人为全市的学校制造自行车。

cards.example_en: During the play, the actor wore a mask and played a brave hero.
cards.example_zh: 演出时，这位演员戴着面具，扮演一位勇敢的英雄。

cards.example_en: He is not materialistic and prefers books to expensive gifts.
cards.example_zh: 他并不贪图物质，比起昂贵的礼物更喜欢书。

cards.example_en: We shared a cold melon after playing basketball in the sun.
cards.example_zh: 在太阳下打完篮球后，我们分吃了一个冰镇甜瓜。

cards.example_en: Can you mend the hole in my school bag before Monday?
cards.example_zh: 你能在星期一之前补好我书包上的破洞吗？

cards.example_en: Yesterday the messenger brought our team a letter from the coach.
cards.example_zh: 昨天，信使给我们队带来了教练的一封信。

cards.example_en: The singer held the mike and sang for the whole school.
cards.example_zh: 歌手握着麦克风，为全校演唱。

cards.example_en: To build a sports centre, the millionaire gave a large sum of money.
cards.example_zh: 为了建造体育中心，那位百万富翁捐了一大笔钱。

cards.example_en: She collects miniature houses and keeps them on her desk.
cards.example_zh: 她收集微型房屋，并把它们摆在书桌上。

cards.example_en: At seven our minibus left the school gate for the museum.
cards.example_zh: 七点，我们的小型公共汽车从校门口出发去博物馆。

word.example_en: She is keen on public speaking.
